description: Compute a US paycheck for 2026: gross, each tax and pre-tax deduction, and take-home pay per paycheck and per year, for a salary or an hourly rate (overtime over 40 hours at 1.5 times) in any state or DC. Federal withholding follows the annual tax on wages; local city and county taxes are not included (the answer names them when material).

health_per_paycheck.description: Pre-tax health premium per paycheck, dollars. Default 0.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate in dollars, instead of salary.

hours_per_week.description: Hours a week with hourly_rate (over 40 paid at 1.5 times). Default 40.

k401_percent.description: Pre-tax 401(k) contribution, percent of gross. Default 0.

residency.description: resident (default), nonresident (e.g. H-1B first year: taxed as single), student (F/J/M/Q nonresident: no FICA).

salary.description: Annual gross salary in dollars. Give this or hourly_rate.

state.description: Two-letter state code or name: TX, CA, new-york, DC.

name: calculate_paycheck
title: Calculate take-home pay
